content.value: Distinguish between aquifer and aquitard. A 150 mm diameter tube well 1 (10) produces 100 lps with a drawdown of 3 m and a circle of influence of 120 m in diameter. The static depth of water in the tube well is 40 m. Calculate the co-efficient of permeability of the aquifer in which the tube well is sunk.
